gameDescriptionHtml:
The apocalypse is over. The dead are hungry. And you’re running the only diner in town.

Welcome to Zombie Diner, a unique blend of diner management, survival, and gruesome gastronomy. In a world where civilization has collapsed, the undead have developed a taste for the finer things in undeath—namely, expertly prepared human cuisine. You’re the chef, and business is booming.

GET READY FOR THE NIGHT SHIFT – Order fresh ingredients (sourced in questionable ways), manage your pantry, and craft a menu of horrifyingly delicious meals. From “Brain Tacos” to “Sloppy Joes,” every dish needs precision and a steady hand.

NIGHTTIME IS FOR SERVICE – When the sun goes down, the customers crawl out. Take orders from your discerning zombie clientele and serve them quickly before their patience (and your reputation) runs out. The faster you are, the more money you’ll earn.

WHEN A MENU JUST WON’T DO… – Not every customer is a five-star patron. If a zombie’s hunger timer runs out, they’ll forget their manners and come for your brains instead of your food. Grab your trusty shotgun and defend your livelihood in a frantic, life-or-death struggle.

Game Features

  • RUN YOUR OWN DINER: MANAGE RESOURCES, COOK, AND SERVE YOUR UNIQUE CLIENTELE.
  • MASTER THE GRUESOME MENU: LEARN TO CRAFT GROTESQUE YET DELICIOUS DISHES.
  • SURVIVE THE NIGHT: HANDLE THE HUNGRY HORDES AND FACE OFF AGAINST AGGRESSIVE CUSTOMERS.
  • UPGRADE YOUR KITCHEN: USE YOUR EARNINGS TO BUY BETTER EQUIPMENT, MORE INGREDIENTS, AND ESSENTIAL AMMUNITION.
